notes: StrataIMD is a fee-free ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 STRATA once to msg.sender, the immediate deployer. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the requested paired token and a 0.3% swap fee, separate from the token's zero transfer fee. pool.initialPrice is a 1:1 sqrtPriceX96 provenance reference only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply, accounting for currency ordering.
